summary: Implemented open-in-Explorer jump capability from all results surfaces (largest files list, virtualized folder tree, top-level results list, and unreadable-folders list). Built pure path planner (ShellReveal.Plan) to detect shell mis-parsed names and fall back to the nearest addressable ancestor, background STA reveal runner (ShellReveal.RevealAsync) using SHParseDisplayName and SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems, and unit-testable Walk delegate seam. Wired WPF OpenInExplorer routed command with Ctrl+Enter gesture, per-row ContextMenu, and non-blocking status line reporting exact, ancestor, hidden, and error outcomes.

files.why: Implements pure Plan, STA RevealAsync, unit-testable Walk delegate seam, and Shell32 P/Invoke interop (SHParseDisplayName, SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems, ILFree).
Exposes LongPath publicly so that display-join helpers are accessible from App without duplicating path logic.
Adds full display Path property to TopLevelRow.
Constructs TopLevelRow with full path via LongPath.Child(root, r.Name).
Adds lazy FullPath property computed via ScanStore.GetPath(entry) on non-root nodes (returning Name for root).
Adds RowContextMenu resource with Open in Explorer MenuItem, CommandBindings on Window, ItemContainerStyle with ContextMenu on result surfaces, and RevealStatus TextBlock.
Adds OpenInExplorer routed command, PathOf resolver, unreadable row record, async reveal handler, and status message formatter.
xUnit unit tests covering Plan theories, unaddressable names, root shapes, long paths, deleted items, and failing shell calls.
Implements reveal hook mode: finds rows across surfaces, triggers ContextMenu MenuItem click, waits for status to settle, and logs JSON lines.
Adds FSA_HOOK_REVEAL to hook variables, R-001 to cases list, Invoke-RevealRun helper, and Test-R001 test case asserting ShellWindows selections.
Architecture rules twinned and appended by design stage.

tests.note: Ran full Core test suite: 295 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, including all architecture rules and 35 ShellRevealTests.

Ran reveal window case in published app with FsaWindowHook: verified largest-files list, folder tree, unaddressable name (dup.), hidden+system file note, junction, symlink, unreadable row, and top-level stopped row selections in Explorer.
Ran tree window case T-001: 34 checks passed cleanly, confirming tree virtualization and expanders remain healthy.
Ran largest-files window case B-001: 27 checks passed cleanly.
Ran kinds breakdown window case K-001: 22 checks passed cleanly.
Ran shipped published app on real %TEMP% directory (97,669 files, 78,267 folders): completed in 19.3 s with exit code 0 and valid schema 1 report.

obligations.how: Verified open a file from the largest-files list in Explorer via context menu click in WindowCases Test-R001, asserting Shell.Application.Windows() observes the parent window with the file selected.

Verified open a non-root folder from the folder tree at depth 2+ in Test-R001, obtaining full path via FolderTreeNode.FullPath (ScanStore.GetPath) and asserting the folder is selected in its parent in Explorer.

Verified scan root shapes (drive root 'C:\', bare 'C:', UNC root '\\server\share') in ShellRevealTests.Plan_RootShapes_CandidatesAndStopAtRoot, confirming candidates stop at root and ancestor chains never yield 'C:'.

Verified long paths of ~300 and ~600 characters (components <= 100) in ShellRevealTests.Plan_LongPaths_NotTruncated, verifying paths are not truncated and extended prefixes are stripped to display form.

Verified unaddressable names (trailing dot, trailing space, reserved device names with/without extension, and sub-items under unaddressable ancestors) in ShellRevealTests and Test-R001, confirming ancestor fallback and that decoy 'dup' is never selected.

Verified unusual but addressable names (' lead', 'a,b;c.txt', emoji, '%TEMP%.txt', 'dup' without dot) in ShellRevealTests.Plan_UnusualAddressableNames_StaysExact and Test-R001, observing exact selection in Explorer.

Verified deleted items in ShellRevealTests.Walk_ItemDeleted_ClimbsToParent (climbs to parent with Reason=NoLongerExists) and Walk_EntireChainDeleted_ReturnsFailed (returns Failed 0x80070003 when all candidates missing).

Verified hidden and hidden+system items in ShellRevealTests.Walk_HiddenAndSystemAttributes_DetectedOnExactItem and Test-R001, confirming Hidden/System attributes are reported and the explanatory status note is displayed.

Verified junctions and symbolic links in ShellRevealTests.Plan_JunctionOrSymlink_ExactItemFirst and Test-R001, creating real links via Developer Mode and observing exact selection in Explorer without following link targets.

Verified Walk stops immediately on failing shell calls that are not 'not found' (E_ACCESSDENIED 0x80070005, ERROR_BAD_NETPATH 0x80070035) in ShellRevealTests.Walk_AccessDeniedOrNetworkError_StopsWithoutClimbing without climbing.
Verified right-click context menu on an unselected tree row in Test-R001, confirming CommandParameter resolves to that row's DataContext via PlacementTarget.DataContext rather than SelectedItem.

Verified clean paths for unreadable folders (UnreadableRow.Path) and top-level rows (TopLevelRow.Path) during/after a stopped scan in Test-R001, confirming reveals succeed with clean paths and no store calls.

Verified offering the command on empty paths in ShellRevealTests.CanExecute_EmptyOrPlaceholder_ReturnsFalse: Plan throws on empty/relative paths, PathOf returns empty string for placeholder/empty rows, and CanExecute evaluates to false.
